com.altastata.api.accountsetup

Class RSAUserAccountSetupHandler

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.altastata.api.accountsetup.RSAUserAccountSetupHandler
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    UserAccountSetupHandlerInterface

    public class RSAUserAccountSetupHandler
extends java.lang.Object
implements UserAccountSetupHandlerInterface
    RSA-based implementation of the UserAccountSetupHandlerInterface. Manages RSA keypair generation, PEM serialization/deserialization, local key storage, and user metadata packaging for traditional RSA encryption/decryption environments.
